entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Destruction is for every open slanderer, backbiter.
Who accumulated wealth, counting it over and over.
Does he think that his wealth will keep him on earth forever?
Never! He will certainly be thrown into the crushing one.
And what have you understood what is the crushing one?
(It is) the Fire of Allah that is ablaze.
Which will climb on to the hearts.
Indeed, it (i.e. the Fire) will be closed up upon them.
